English translation from the Modern Amharic of the EOTC Bible (nehemiah-osc.org) by Claude (Anthropic) with collaborator, May 2026. Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication (archive.org/details/three-books-of-meqabyan-cc0-translation). Apparatus integrates Josef Horovitz, 'Das äthiopische Maccabäerbuch,' Zeitschrift für Assyriologie XIX (1905), pp. 194-233 — PD primary scholarly study. 64-citation third-pass audit verdict matrix; 57 verified, 4 errors corrected, 3 interpretive readings flagged, 7 newly discovered parallels added. Dating widened to Aksumite-to-Solomonic Ethiopian Christian range (4th-14th c. CE); precise composition date undetermined in current scholarship per Horovitz 1905 non-commitment. Three books: 1 Mq 36 chapters (Maqabis-of-Benjamin martyrology vs Ṣiruṣaydan); 2 Mq 21 chapters (Maqabis-of-Moab conversion + sons' martyrdom + Ṣiruṣaydan's death); 3 Mq 10 chapters (homiletic + angelological dialogue + Satan-refused-Adam tradition + resurrection-doctrine).

OPENS Ch 26 — HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR: late-narrative-arc development. The chapter likely transitions from the homiletic-instruction arc (Chs 20-25) to a second-narrative-arc preparing the chapter's salvation-history-compression at Ch 28 (γ.4.8 seed: Cain-to-Esther compression). The late-narrative-arc structural-position parallels the trilogy's compositional-architecture: Chs 2-4 first-martyrdom + Chs 5-19 first-homiletic-arc + Chs 20-25 second-homiletic-arc + Chs 26-32 second-narrative-arc + Chs 33-36 final-resurrection-capstone. The late-narrative-arc-pattern parallels the rhythmic-narrative-and-homiletic alternation common in Tewahedo broader-canonical literature: 1 ENOCH alternates (Watchers narrative → Parables homiletic-and-cosmic-narrative → Astronomical instruction → Animal-Apocalypse → Epistle-of-Enoch — γ.4.4 Mäṣḥafä Hēnok structure); JUBILEES alternates (Genesis rewrite + halakhic-instructional sections — γ.4.5 Mäṣḥafä Kufāle structure). The Meqabyan late-narrative-arc-position likely articulates a similar structural-rhythm.

HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR — likely development of HISTORICAL-EXEMPLA theme. The historical-exempla-of-the-faithful theme parallels: HEBREWS 11 (the faith-heroes catalog — Abraham + Isaac + Jacob + Joseph + Moses + Rahab + Gideon + Barak + Samson + Jephthah + David + Samuel + the prophets); 1 MACCABEES 2:51-60 (Mattathias's deathbed faith-heroes-roll-call); 4 MACCABEES 16:16-23 + 18:11-19 (the mother's-faith-heroes-speech to her sons); SIRACH 44-50 ('Praise of Famous Men' — the Hebrew-Bible faith-heroes-roll-call); WISDOM OF SOLOMON 10:1-21 (Wisdom-leads-the-fathers); 1 CLEMENT 4-7 + 17-18 (the Apostolic-Father faith-exempla-roll-call). Tewahedo Sǝnkǝsar (Synaxarium) preserves the canonical-exempla rubric for daily-saints'-readings — drawing on Hebrews 11 + LXX-Maccabean + Wisdom faith-roll-call parallels. The Meqabyan chapter likely articulates a faith-heroes catalog preparing Ch 28's Cain-to-Esther salvation-history-compression.

HOMILETIC-GENRE ANCHOR — likely development of MOSES-AS-FOUNDATIONAL-PARADIGM theme. The Moses-paradigm theme parallels: EXODUS-DEUTERONOMY (the foundational Moses-narrative across the Pentateuch); ACTS 7 (Stephen's Moses-typology speech); HEBREWS 3:1-6 + 11:23-29 (Moses-as-faithful-servant + Moses-as-faith-hero); 2 CORINTHIANS 3:7-18 (Moses-veil-of-the-OT contrast with Christ-revelation); JUBILEES 1:1-29 (Moses-as-recipient-of-the-Jubilees-revelation — γ.4.5 Mäṣḥafä Kufāle anchor); JOSEPHUS Antiquities 2-4 (Moses-narrative-expansion). Patristic-tradition: GREGORY OF NYSSA De Vita Moysis (the foundational Christian Moses-life-and-spiritual-progress treatise); ORIGEN Homilies on Exodus + Numbers (Moses-allegorical-spiritual-reading); AMBROSE De Mysteriis + De Sacramentis (Moses-baptismal-typology). Tewahedo Moses-tradition preserves Moses-as-foundational-paradigm for the Ethiopian-priest-king symbology (paralleling the Tewahedo-Solomonic-lineage that runs Adam → Noah → Abraham → Moses → David → Solomon → Christ → Tewahedo-Emperors per Kǝbrä Nägäśt).
